Extends the Bot's Full access policy to file tools as well as commands, including absolute paths anywhere available to the gateway account. Workspace mode remains confined to the primary workspace, attached folders, authorized read roots, and private temporary storage.

Wire protocol 82, gateway configuration 26, checkpoint payload 17, and SQLite schema 10 are unchanged from 0.15.31. Existing cloud gateways can upgrade in place; no state conversion is required.
